info.title: daxalgo-bundle
info.description: Portable CLI for packing, signing, verifying, and inspecting passive DaxAlgo strategy bundles.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Passively inspect content and signature presence without loading payload code.

commands.name: sign
commands.description: Add a publisher signature. Defaults to a safe in-place rewrite.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Validate content and authenticate a publisher signature.
